key_insight: CORD selectively removes conflicting gradient components when combining reinforcement learning and self-distillation, rather than relying on a mixing weight alone.
engineering_relevance: CORD can be added to different joint-training recipes without changing their objectives, combining gradients once per optimizer mini-batch.
method: Choose which objective to protect independently of the condition that triggers projection.
Use a nearest-point formulation to obtain a closed-form gradient update.
Characterize the update’s first-order effect on the protected objective before optimizer transformations.
evidence_signal: Across three training recipes, CORD improves ALFWorld success by 1.5–15.9 percentage points; on WebShop, it improves two of three pairs, including SDAR from 60.7% to 64.6%.
watch_item: Protection direction and projection gate must be chosen together; distillation design and mixing weight still matter, and the first-order characterization precedes optimizer transformations.
paper_title: CORD: Conflict-Aware Optimization for Joint RL and Distillation in Agents
